description: A plant operations director must authorize a two-product laser-cutting campaign to recover an urgent order and finalize the machine, setup, quantity, shipment, and first-off inspection plan, with input from quality, logistics, and maintenance.

shared_context.S1: The plant has an urgent order for two laser-cut housing variants, H-22 and H-31, and the campaign must be completed this week.
shared_context.S2: Laser Cell 4 and Laser Cell 5 are the available production assets for this campaign.
shared_context.S3: Cell 4 is currently idle, while Cell 5 is completing a routine job that can be released after its current batch.
shared_context.S4: Mara makes the binding campaign decision; the standard campaign-review routine is for quality, logistics, and maintenance to report their findings before the production plan is finalized.

PF1.text: The customer-approved drawing revision requires 24 first-off units across the H-22 and H-31 campaign to receive 100% dimensional inspection before release; Elliot confirmed this in the customer quality portal yesterday, but the revised requirement has not yet been attached to the campaign traveler.

PF2.text: The confirmed order is for exactly 620 H-22 housings and 430 H-31 housings, with all units staged for shipment by Thursday at 16:00; Priya received the signed shipping instruction this morning, but it has not yet been entered into the production schedule.

PF3.text: Cell 4 already has the compatible 0.8 mm nozzle for both housing variants, but maintenance must complete exactly 120 minutes of optical warm-up and alignment before cutting; Cell 5 would require a five-hour nozzle changeover, and Jonas's inspection note is still in the maintenance folder rather than the campaign packet.

acceptance_conditions: Cell 4 must be selected for the campaign.
Exactly 120 minutes of optical warm-up and alignment must be scheduled.
The campaign must produce exactly 620 H-22 housings.
The campaign must produce exactly 430 H-31 housings.
All units must be staged by Thursday at 16:00.
Exactly 24 first-off units must be inspected.
The 24 first-off units must receive 100% dimensional inspection.
A laser setup commitment must be recorded for Cell 4.
A first-off inspection commitment must be recorded.
The quality requirement must be cited as justification.

decisive_facts.why: The customer drawing revision changes first-off control from the routine unspecified plan to exactly 24 units receiving 100% dimensional inspection and requires that quality finding to be cited.
The signed shipping instruction changes the campaign quantities to exactly 620 H-22 and 430 H-31 housings and sets the staging deadline to Thursday at 16:00.
The nozzle compatibility finding makes Cell 4 the correct asset and changes the setup plan to exactly 120 minutes of optical warm-up and alignment.
